known.title: Request correction 6 drops the blank-goal check from `new` on the false premise that check 13 already refuses a Goal that holds only the Mode line.
known.locator: Research, Decisions, entry 6 (line 49); Steps, new_title (line 59); Goal, outcomes, fourth bullet (line 14)
known.summary: Request correction (decoy). The entry narrows the request "reject ... a blank goal" because check 13 supposedly refuses a Goal section whose only content is the Mode line, so a whitespace-only goal would fail the first check and every edit. False at repo_ref: check 13 (plugins/plan-lifecycle/skills/productivity/plan-manager/scripts/plan.mjs:267-268) only counts lines that match `^Mode: (plan-and-implement|plan-only)$` in Goal and fails when the count is not 1. planTemplate (plan.mjs:272-274) always writes exactly one Mode line under the goal line, and createPlan refuses only an empty --goal string (plan.mjs:645) and newlines (648). No other check reads Goal content (checkPlan, plan.mjs:165-270). Scenario: `new --title t --goal "   "` creates a plan whose Goal holds no outcome; `check`, `edit`, and the mutators of step mutator_validation accept it. The Goal (line 14) expects that a whitespace-only goal never yields a plan that passes check, and the user asked for the refusal before anything is created; step new_title adds no goal rule and Acceptance A1 has no such case. Fix: drop the false reason, make step new_title also refuse a goal that is blank after trimming before the gh issue create call, and add the plan-cli.mjs case.

known.title: Step path_detector renames the shipped export `machinePathCitations` to `machinePaths`, but no Files cell lists the plan-lifecycle self-test that pins the closed export list.
known.locator: Steps, path_detector, Task and Files (line 60); Research, Facts, plan-skill-phases importer bullet (line 34); Acceptance A3, A5, A6 (lines 70, 72, 73)
known.summary: The step changes the shipped plan.mjs API: it renames the export and changes its return value, and it moves only the importer in scripts/tests/plan-skill-phases.mjs. plugins/plan-lifecycle/test/selftest.mjs (repo_ref lines 27-32) imports plan.mjs and asserts `Object.keys(planCli).sort()` deepEqual `PLAN_CLI_EXPORTS = ["checkPlan", "machinePathCitations"]` with the message that plan.mjs must expose only the closed plan CLI API. After the rename the keys are checkPlan and machinePaths, so the self-test fails. Acceptance A3 runs that self-test, and scripts/ci.mjs:490-493 runs it inside gatePlugin, so A5 (`ci.mjs --plugin plan-lifecycle`) and A6 (full gate) fail too. The file is in no Files cell, and Research line 34 names plan-skill-phases.mjs as the only importer. Fix: add plugins/plan-lifecycle/test/selftest.mjs to the Files cell of step path_detector and update PLAN_CLI_EXPORTS to the new name, or keep the old export name.

protected.summary: User: new and claim exit 1 when the read-back shows another login next to the acting login, and they remove no assignment (neither the other login nor their own). Sound: docs/PLAN.md:107-112 says no lifecycle command transfers ownership and taking a plan from another owner is a deliberate manual GitHub action, so removing the other login is ruled out. plan-contract.md:264-265 says a write has no precondition, so an automatic undo of the own assignment is another racy write. The resulting two-assignee state is fail-safe at repo_ref: readPlanIssue refuses every mutating command when a foreign owner is present (plan.mjs:510-512, claimPlan 682-684), and review records are trusted only with exactly one assignee (plan-contract.md:191-192, AGENTS.md:103-105). The contract rule that a refusing command writes nothing (plan-contract.md:303-305) still holds for the foreign owner seen in the pre-write read; the post-write case is a race the API cannot prevent. Step assignee_verify carries it out (Done when: exit 1 after an extra assignee). No instruction file or contract rule requires an automatic repair.

User: retire keeps the close-then-cleanup order, and a rerun on a closed not-planned plan that still carries a recognized phase label skips the close and finishes the cleanup; any other closed plan stays refused. Sound: retire and archive share one cleanup call after the close (plan.mjs:1015-1028); closed reads ignore phase labels, so a leftover label never changes the derived status `retired` (plan-contract.md:74-75, statusFromIssue plan.mjs:609-617). Cleanup first would leave an open plan with no phase label after a failed close, which derives `unlabelled` and fails check 2 (plan.mjs:181-183). The contract fixes no order: it says retire closes with NOT_PLANNED and removes every phase label (plan-contract.md:396-397), and docs/PLAN.md:57 says retire strips every phase label that an earlier edit left behind, which the rerun does. The refused second retire on a fully retired plan stays as plan-cli.mjs:1948-1949 pins. Step retire_rerun carries it out with its own test.

Request correction: Asked "run the full validation before every mutating write"; Did: status, step, and claim run the 13 checks on the record as their write leaves it (new body plus post-write labels); edit keeps its existing check of the new body; archive and retire keep their own preconditions. Sound: a pre-write check fails check 2 on every unlabelled or unreadable open plan (plan.mjs:181-183), while status deliberately starts from those states to repair the phase label (plan.mjs:841; docs/PLAN.md:52-55), so the literal request would remove the only CLI label repair. edit already validates its new body (plan.mjs:800). archive is a verifier with its own proof rules (plan-contract.md:366-397), and the Enforcement boundary lets each mutating command enforce the preconditions visible to it without a full-check rule (plan-contract.md:399-406). Validating the post-write record also enforces the filled-Research rule at the status change (plan-contract.md:106-107). A plan that cannot be claimed because it is unlabelled is repaired by `status`, which claims an unassigned plan in the same write (plan.mjs:513, 576-579). Step mutator_validation carries it out; no instruction file at repo_ref requires validation before retire or archive.
